findings.hpExample: The Agriculture index labels the route HIM UNNATI YOJANA while its page describes the initiative as Him Krishi Yojana; the baseline already uses 'Him Unnati / Him Krishi cluster programme'.
findings.requiredRecordBehavior: Keep one canonical scheme identity, store both official names as aliases, and do not count the page wording as a second scheme.
findings.laterGeneralizationRequirement: Add alias/successor fields and name-effective dates for all jurisdictions.

findings.hpExample: MoFPI presents PMKSY and PMFME component trees as navigable scheme pages, while SMDI guidelines name five separately administered components under one parent scheme.
findings.requiredRecordBehavior: Record the parent once and model components beneath it unless an independently operative application route justifies a component publication.
findings.laterGeneralizationRequirement: Require parent/component relationships and prevent component inflation in published counts.

findings.hpExample: The HP SC/ST Development Corporation index mixes its own Swarojgar/Study Loan routes with finance delivered in collaboration with NSFDC, NSTFDC and NSKFDC, and repeats HIMSWAVLAMBAN (PM-AJAY).
findings.requiredRecordBehavior: Separate scheme owner, funder/apex corporation, state channelising agency and lender; deduplicate repeated labels before publication.
findings.laterGeneralizationRequirement: Add reusable owner/funder/channel/lender roles for institutional-finance schemes.

findings.hpExample: MoFPI's enduring Cold Chain component has a 2026 proposal call and corrigendum specifically for multi-product food irradiation units.
findings.requiredRecordBehavior: Keep the enduring scheme identity separate from each dated call/window and publish intake only from current call evidence.
findings.laterGeneralizationRequirement: Model calls/windows as time-bounded children of durable schemes.

findings.hpExample: The dedicated Startup Himachal incentive-procedure URL returned HTTP 502 while the parent Emerging Himachal Single Window index remained live and linked Startup Himachal.
findings.requiredRecordBehavior: Record failed-access for the broken endpoint, retain the parent-page lead, and do not infer current intake or verified-none.
findings.laterGeneralizationRequirement: Track endpoint-level retrieval outcomes separately from scheme-level existence.

findings.hpExample: The Fisheries notice board carries a 2024 physical/financial target allotment for carp ponds and routes implementation through Assistant Directors/district offices.
findings.requiredRecordBehavior: Attach district/target notices to the state parent; do not convert each district allocation into a scheme, and require a current district check before saying intake is open.
findings.laterGeneralizationRequirement: Support geography-scoped intake and allocation evidence below a statewide scheme.

findings.hpExample: The same official Fisheries stream lists 'New Scheme for Construction of Carp Fish Ponds including Input Cost' in August 2024 and 'Mukhyamantri Carp Matsya Palan Yojana' in November 2024.
findings.requiredRecordBehavior: Create both candidate labels, disposition the earlier title as a possible alias/successor only after comparing the SOPs, and publish no duplicate count.
findings.laterGeneralizationRequirement: Require document comparison before merging conflicting official titles.

findings.hpExample: The Transport notice board hosts the June 2026 e-Taxi application link but explicitly says the scheme was launched by Labour, Employment and Overseas Placement; earlier SOP material assigns subsidy processing to Labour and vehicle deployment to Transport.
findings.requiredRecordBehavior: Use one RGSSY component record with distinct owner, intake host, subsidy processor and deployment channel rather than duplicating by department.
findings.laterGeneralizationRequirement: Represent multi-agency operational roles independently of the scheme owner.

findings.hpExample: The HP eServices directory exposes application links for Doodh Protsahan Yojana and Him Kukkut Palan Yojna, but the directory itself does not state operative benefit terms or window dates.
findings.requiredRecordBehavior: Use service endpoints as application-route/intake leads only; require the department notification or guideline for hard claims.
findings.laterGeneralizationRequirement: Grade portal endpoints separately from operative scheme instruments.

findings.hpExample: The official HBCFDC scheme page is accessible but search metadata and displayed income/loan limits appear materially old, while it still names General Loan, Swarnima and education routes.
findings.requiredRecordBehavior: Record candidates and the official index check, but do not publish current amounts, eligibility or intake without a recent operative source.
findings.laterGeneralizationRequirement: Distinguish official provenance from temporal currency and require recency for hard claims.

findings.hpExample: The bounded sweep could not retrieve the HPSRLM, Urban Development, Forest and Cooperation portals; the failures did not establish absence of additional routes.
findings.requiredRecordBehavior: Mark the index check failed-access with a near-term retry and keep coverage candidate-pending; never emit verified-none from a retrieval failure.
findings.laterGeneralizationRequirement: Make verified-none contingent on a successful official sweep and store endpoint failure evidence.

findings.hpExample: The FY 2026-27 Budget index and Economic Survey 2025-26 summarise programme activity and allocations across departments but do not by themselves establish current applicant intake.
findings.requiredRecordBehavior: Allow these sources to create/reconcile leads and budget facets only; require department operative evidence for eligibility, benefit and intake claims.
findings.laterGeneralizationRequirement: Keep existence/budget/intake evidence facets distinct across all state workbooks.
